comparison.objective: Screen media from washers, versus shackling a trailer towing lug and screwing the pin home.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual granular-flow control versus aligning a shackle around a lug and threading a captive pin.
comparison.success_condition: Media recovered, washers retained and screen released versus lug captured and pin fully threaded.
comparison.reason: Threaded fastening around a lug does not exercise screen selection or particle flow.
